title: Singlife Cagayan de Oro Marathon 2026 Review: A Marathon Majors Leg at SM Uptown
seo_title: Singlife Cagayan de Oro Marathon 2026 Review | PH
meta_description: Singlife Cagayan de Oro Marathon 2026 review: December 13 at SM City CDO Uptown -- the Singlife series' Mindanao leg, in a city with proven race capacity.
dek: Set for 13 December 2026 at SM City CDO Uptown, this is the Mindanao leg of RunRio's Singlife Marathon Majors series -- the same brand family as the Singlife Davao Marathon covered elsewhere in this research.
verdict: The Singlife Cagayan de Oro Marathon extends the Singlife Philippine Marathon Majors series -- covered at its Davao leg elsewhere in this research -- to CDO, a city with genuinely proven capacity for large-scale races, having hosted the MILO Marathon's Mindanao-first National Finals in 2024 with over 12,600 participants. Four distances (5K to full marathon), registration already open, and a modern SM Uptown venue give this leg real operational strength. As part of a multi-city series, it likely carries similar production values to Davao's debut edition.

sections.heading: Part of the Singlife Marathon Majors Series
paragraphs: This race offers four distances -- 5K, 10K, 21.1K and the 42.195K full marathon -- at SM City CDO Uptown, organised by RUNRIO Inc. [1] It joins the Singlife Davao Marathon covered elsewhere in this research batch as another leg of the same Singlife Philippine Marathon Majors series, jointly run with Kinetix Sports and SM Supermalls.

sections.heading: A City With Proven Race Capacity
paragraphs: Cagayan de Oro has demonstrated genuine capacity for large-field races -- in 2024, the city hosted the MILO Marathon's National Finals for the first time ever in Mindanao, drawing over 12,600 participants, covered elsewhere in this research batch. [1] That track record gives real confidence in CDO's ability to handle another major marathon-distance event.

sections.heading: A Modern Mall-Anchored Venue
paragraphs: SM City CDO Uptown is a newer, modern mall development also used by the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia's CDO Leg 3 covered elsewhere in this research, giving the race village built-in parking, shelter and amenities. [2] That repeat use suggests a genuinely tested venue for the city's growing race calendar.

sections.heading: Registration Already Open
paragraphs: Unlike several other RunRio-organised races in this research batch still awaiting registration confirmation, the Singlife Cagayan de Oro Marathon is already open for sign-up. [1] That's a meaningful advantage for runners wanting to plan travel now rather than wait.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want to run a Marathon Majors-series race in a Mindanao city with genuinely proven capacity for large events, the Singlife Cagayan de Oro Marathon on 13 December 2026 is a strong, low-risk pick. Registration is already open across all four distances.
